title: Image semantic-enrichment fields (fragment)
description: Solr fields containing semantic-enrichment results for an image content item, including classification labels, descriptive keywords, and image embeddings. This fragment is composed into the complete image Solr document.

descriptive_keywords_ss.title: Descriptive keywords
descriptive_keywords_ss.description: Automatically generated descriptive keywords associated with the image.

type_l0_tp.title: Visual content
type_l0_tp.description: Classifies whether the detected page region is a visual content or a non-visual region incorrectly identified as an image during layout recognition.

oneOf.title: Image
oneOf.description: A visual content intended to be classified.

oneOf.title: Not an image
oneOf.description: A non-visual page region, such as enlarged lettering, incorrectly identified as an image.

oneOf.title: Undetermined
oneOf.description: The classification could not be determined.

type_l1_tp.title: Technique
type_l1_tp.description: Classifies the technique of the original visual content, distinguishing photographs from all other techniques.

oneOf.title: Photograph
oneOf.description: A visual content reproduced from a photograph.

oneOf.title: Not a photograph
oneOf.description: A visual content reproduced using a technique other than photography.

oneOf.title: Undetermined or not applicable
oneOf.description: The technique could not be determined or does not apply to the detected region.

type_l2_tp.title: Communication goal
type_l2_tp.description: Classifies the broad communicative purpose for which the visual content was included in the newspaper, independently of its depicted subject.

oneOf.title: Decorative
oneOf.description: A visual element included primarily for aesthetic purposes rather than to convey direct information.

oneOf.title: Informative or illustrative
oneOf.description: A visual content intended to convey factual information, clarify, illustrate, or support an article.

oneOf.title: Advertising
oneOf.description: A visual content promoting a product, service, business, event, place, or other concept.

oneOf.title: Entertainment
oneOf.description: A visual content intended to amuse, engage, or provide leisure to readers.

oneOf.title: Undetermined or not applicable
oneOf.description: The communication goal could not be determined or does not apply to the detected region.

type_l3_tp.title: Visual content type
type_l3_tp.description: Classifies the form, structure, and representational characteristics of the visual content.

oneOf.description: A single humorous, satirical, or exaggerated drawing, including editorial cartoons and caricatures.
A sequence of two or more illustrated panels, typically with dialogue inside speech bubbles.
A narrative illustration accompanying a serialized story, usually with prose narration rather than dialogue bubbles.
A printed puzzle, riddle, crossword, board-game layout, or other recreational game-related illustration.
A visual representation of data, such as a bar chart, line graph, pie chart, or statistical plot.
A precise technical diagram, such as an architectural blueprint, engineering schematic, or mechanical drawing.
A depiction focused on clothing, accessories, or fashion trends, including fashion sketches and photographs of models.
A close-up depiction centred on an individual person, including formal portraits, profiles, and artistic renderings.
A depiction of people interacting, undertaking activities, or forming part of a larger scene or crowd.
A depiction of a natural landscape, cityscape, or environmental scene in which people are not the main subject.
A map showing rock formations or geological features, such as faults, folds, and geological units.
A map emphasizing territorial boundaries, political divisions, and place names.
A physical map showing natural features or a roadmap showing transport routes and networks.
A detailed, scaled plan of a specific place, building, district, or infrastructure layout.
A map depicting meteorological conditions, such as temperature, precipitation, cloud cover, wind, or atmospheric pressure.
A non-geographical infographic representing weather conditions through charts, symbols, or meteorological indicators.
A visual content composed primarily of stylised text, often used in advertisements.
A depiction centred on a discrete object rather than a person, scene, map, or other defined visual type.
An ornamental or illustrated section title, potentially combining decorative lettering, figurative elements, or abstract embellishment.
A visual content that cannot be assigned to any other available class.

oneOf.title: Undetermined or not applicable
oneOf.description: The visual content type could not be determined or does not apply to the detected region.

dinov2_emb_v1024.title: DINOv2 image embedding (1024D)
dinov2_emb_v1024.description: Dense vector representation of the image computed using the DINOv2 model. The vector has a fixed dimensionality of 1024.

openclip_emb_v768.title: OpenCLIP image embedding (768D)
openclip_emb_v768.description: Dense vector representation of the image computed using the OpenCLIP model. The vector has a fixed dimensionality of 768.
